value.rationale: The cited spectral-rigidity framework distinguishes where discrete unit-circle crossings can occur but leaves their nonlinear outcome undetermined; this natural minimal polynomial self-damping model has an exact attracting rather than repelling invariant circle, with computed nonzero first Lyapunov sign and leading amplitude. It provides a concrete analytical distinction between stable continuous ecology and oscillations artificially introduced by coarse Euler discretization, useful for interpreting numerical bifurcation diagnostics. Does not claim a broad theorem beyond this motivated realization.
